source_meta.name: CAPSTONE CA Strategy — Advance Tax Playbook

chunks.text: Project total tax from realized gains, expected interest, and other income; subtract TDS/TCS credits; compare cumulative paid vs required instalments under Section 208; pay shortfall before due date to avoid Section 234C interest.
User executes challan ITNS 280 externally. CAPSTONE provides projected liability, due date, and interest risk — never initiates payment.
